made: during the resumed main-grid run, before any timing result was analysed
event: the AC adapter dropped out a second time (battery status 1 at 94%) for longer than the 120 s allowed by amendment 6; the harness refused and stopped after 2 completed main-grid invocations. AC returned afterwards. The cause (cable, adapter, outlet or power management) is not determined from the software side.
change: AC_WAIT_S raised from 120 to 1800 s: the harness waits up to 30 minutes for AC to return before refusing; an outer loop restarts it (up to 20 times, 60 s apart) so a refusal after a long outage resumes by itself. The no-timing-on-battery rule stands; every record carries env_before, power_after and waited_for_ac_s, and records whose power_after is not ok are flagged in the analysis (not dropped).
scope: measured commands, grid, repetitions, thread rule, decision rule unchanged.
